svg.desc: Cairo Historic Panorama LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Housing, Utilities and Urban Communities STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 9 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Electrical Engineering Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Project Overview The project for the development of the historic Cairo area, which includes residential, administrative and tourist buildings. BECT's scope included project management, site supervision, conceptual design, detailed drawings and tender documents. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, landscape design, architectural design, electrical engineering, structural / civil engineering and mechanical engineering.
